_comment: DEMO CONTENT for a portfolio project. Hollow Medical Center is FICTIONAL, invented for this demo. It is not a real hospital and must not be presented as one. Replace every line before this is used with real patients.
_schedule_note: `schedule` is the single source of truth for the slot grid and for the spoken hours. A department with no `weekly` block is open around the clock; every department here keeps outpatient office hours instead. The emergency room is not a bookable department.
_timezone_note: schedule.timezone is the hospital's own timezone, used for rendering. Appointments are stored in UTC, and callers can give times in any timezone they like.
_hours_note: Outpatient clinic hours, not the emergency room. The ER runs around the clock and is not bookable: see `emergency_room`. Sourced hours: dentistry 7:00-17:30 plus Saturdays (ADA), eye care 8:30-17:00 (ophthalmology), dermatology 8:00-17:00, orthopedics 8:00-16:30, pediatrics 7:00-18:00. The rest follow the common US outpatient pattern of early morning to late afternoon, Monday to Friday. Every department is 30 minute slots.

family medicine.description: checkups, colds and flu, everyday illness, ongoing conditions

eye care.description: eye exams, vision tests, glasses and contact lens prescriptions

orthopedics.description: bones, joints, sports injuries, back and knee pain

dermatology.description: skin, hair and nails, rashes, moles

obstetrics and gynecology.description: women's health, pregnancy care, annual exams

physical therapy.description: rehab after injury or surgery, mobility work

_department_aliases: Spoken names callers actually use, mapped to the department key above.
services: Family medicine for checkups, colds and flu, and ongoing conditions
Dentistry, eye care, dermatology and ear nose and throat
Pediatrics for children from birth to eighteen
Orthopedics, cardiology, women's health and physical therapy
Lab work, X-rays and imaging on site
A round the clock emergency room for anything urgent
consultation_fee: A standard office visit is one hundred and eighty dollars without insurance, and a specialist visit is two hundred and fifty. With insurance you'd usually just owe your copay.
payment_methods: We take all major cards, cash, HSA and FSA cards, and we can set up a payment plan if you need one.
insurance: We're in network with most major plans. If you give the front desk your member ID when you arrive they'll verify your benefits before you're seen.
_insurance_note: accepted_plans is the ONLY list the agent may confirm from. Anything not on it gets 'I'd have to check' plus a handover, never a yes. Replace this list with the client's real contracted payers before go-live.
accepted_plans: Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Medical Mutual of Ohio, Medicare and Ohio Medicaid
insurance_unknown_plan: We work with a lot of plans but I wouldn't want to promise yours without checking. Patient services can confirm it in a minute, or bring your card and the desk will verify before you're seen.
visit_advice: Please bring a photo ID, your insurance card, a list of anything you're currently taking, and any records from another provider.
arrival_advice: Come about fifteen minutes early if it's your first visit, so registration doesn't eat into your appointment.
walk_in_policy: We do take walk-ins, though you may wait a while. An appointment is much quicker.
reports_policy: Lab results usually post to your patient portal within two business days, and your provider will reach out if anything needs discussing.
cancellation_policy: Just let us know at least twenty four hours ahead if you can't make it, so we can offer the slot to someone else.
emergency_room: Our emergency room is open twenty four hours a day, seven days a week, and you don't need an appointment for it.
greeting_inbound: Thank you for calling Hollow Medical Center. This is Emma. How can I help you today?
greeting_outbound: Hi, this is Emma calling from Hollow Medical Center. Is now an okay time?
greeting_reminder: Hi, this is Emma from Hollow Medical Center, just calling about your upcoming appointment. Is now an okay time?
